Controls: - CTL-410 (ensure controlled execution — Split-Order & Mixed-Basket Fulfillment (PA-60.2).)
- operational: sub-order orchestration integrity; operational: Ecom Ops Manager split-order monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Orchestration-desync risk**: the sub-orders trigger out of sync (store picks before the drop-ship PO sends), producing inconsistent delivery; mitigated by the atomic-orchestration (all sub-orders trigger together)
- **Consolidation-missed-opportunity risk**: sub-orders ship separately when consolidation would have been cheaper; mitigated by the W2295 consolidation logic
System Touchpoints: - Order orchestration (links to VS-08 / W536 unified order management, W534 multi-origin) — the multi-source coordination
- Inventory (links to VS-05 / W105) — the per-source ATP
- Delivery (links to VS-56 / W548, VS-06 logistics) — the consolidation-vs-separate decision
Time Estimate: Automated; Ecom Ops Manager ~4 hours/month = **~50 hours/year**.

steps.activity: System orchestrates: triggers pick at store, DC, sends drop-ship PO; tracks sub-orders against parent; determines delivery strategy: consolidate at DC, separate deliveries, or consolidate at store

Controls: - CTL-410 (ensure controlled execution — Split-Order & Mixed-Basket Fulfillment (PA-60.2).)
- CTL-410 (SLA-priority override integrity); operational: Logistics Coordinator consolidation-rate review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hold-too-long risk**: the 24-hour hold for consolidation delays the first sub-order past its SLA; mitigated by the SLA-priority override (ship immediately if the SLA is at-risk)

- **Consolidation-never-arrives risk**: the second sub-order is delayed, so the held first sub-order waits 24 hours then ships anyway, gaining nothing; mitigated by the hold-window-limit and the consolidation-rate monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Consolidation engine (links to VS-60 / W2294, VS-56 / W592) — the same-customer/same-DC consolidation logic
- Delivery (links to VS-04 / W52 fleet, VS-56) — the consolidated shipment
- Analytics (links to VS-27 / W113) — the consolidation-rate tracking

steps.activity: System identifies consolidation: same DC, same customer; holds first sub-order 24 hours for consolidation; ships together; reduces cost and improves experience; tracks consolidation rate

fields.Volume: ~3K–5K/month (one register with W534: 7–12% of ecommerce orders)

Automation Opportunity: - Split notification auto-sent with combined view link; CS unified-view auto-populated
Controls: - CTL-410 (ensure controlled execution — Split-Order & Mixed-Basket Fulfillment (PA-60.2).)
- Operational: Ecom Ops Manager comms-effectiveness review (W2305)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Comms-confusion risk**: the split notification confuses the customer (multiple tracking numbers, multiple dates), increasing contact-center load; mitigated by the clear single-CS-contact and the combined app/web view
- **Comms-timing risk**: the notification lands before the customer is ready (e.g., at 2 AM); mitigated by the business-hours notification preference
System Touchpoints: - Customer comms (links to VS-13 / W56 backorder notification, VS-10 / W98) — the split notification
- App/web order view (links to VS-75 / VS-10) — the combined status
- CRM (links to VS-13 / W156 CDP) — the unified customer-service view
Time Estimate: Automated; monitoring absorbed into Ecom Ops.

steps.activity: Proactive: explains split, sub-order tracking numbers, delivery dates per sub-order, single CS contact; customer views combined status in app/web; CS has unified view

fields.Trigger: Customer cancels part of split order

Controls: - CTL-410 (ensure controlled execution — Split-Order & Mixed-Basket Fulfillment (PA-60.2).)
- operational: partial-cancel integrity; promo-adjustment accuracy; operational: CS Supervisor sign-off on partial-cancels >PHP 5K
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cancellation-after-ship risk**: the customer cancels a sub-order that already shipped, requiring a return-not-delivery; mitigated by the cancellation-window (before ship-confirm) and the return-flow fallback

- **Promo-adjustment-complexity risk**: a promo that required the full basket (buy-A-get-B) now needs adjustment on a partial cancellation; mitigated by the promo-rule engine handling the partial-cancel case
System Touchpoints: - Order cancellation (links to VS-10 / W98, VS-16 / W101 refund) — the partial cancellation and refund
- Inventory (links to VS-05 / W105) — the restored ATP
- Finance (links to VS-17 / W9, VS-157) — the partial-revenue and promo-adjustment

steps.activity: System cancels specific sub-order(s), restores inventory, processes partial refund, keeps remaining active; Finance adjusts: partial refund, revenue for fulfilled only, promo adjustments

fields.Trigger: Item becomes unavailable in split order

Automation Opportunity: - Backorder auto-detected; options auto-presented; expiry auto-processed
Controls: - CTL-410 (ensure controlled execution — Split-Order & Mixed-Basket Fulfillment (PA-60.2).)
- operational: backorder integrity; operational: Ecom Ops Manager backorder-resolution-rate review
Pain Points / Risks: - **Backorder-limbo risk**: a backordered sub-order sits unresolved, and the customer forgets/discharges; mitigated by the backorder-expiry and the periodic customer re-confirmation

- **Substitute-rejection risk**: the offered substitute doesn't meet the customer's need, generating a cancellation; mitigated by the substitute-accuracy (the substitute must be functionally equivalent)
System Touchpoints: - Backorder (links to VS-05 / W56 backorder, VS-10 / W98) — the backorder logic
- Substitute (links to VS-01 / W279 product substitution) — the substitute option
- Customer comms (links to VS-13 / W56) — the options notification

steps.activity: System detects: evaluates alternatives (different source, substitute, partial shipment + backorder); customer notified of options; chooses: partial now + backorder later, substitute, or cancel

Automation Opportunity: - Cross-entity fulfillment auto-processed; IC pricing auto-applied; entity-revenue auto-attributed
Controls: - CTL-410 (TP arm's-length — links to VS-72 / W235); CTL-44 (entity-attribution integrity); operational: Finance Manager monthly reconciliation sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **TP-misallocation risk**: the cross-entity transfer price isn't arm's-length, creating a TP exposure; mitigated by the VS-72 TP methodology and documentation

- **Revenue-entity-misattribution risk**: the revenue is recognized by the wrong entity (fulfilling vs. selling), distorting entity P&L; mitigated by the system-controlled entity-attribution (the selling entity, not the fulfilling, recognizes revenue)
System Touchpoints: - Cross-entity fulfillment (links to VS-72 / W2583 IC invoice, VS-17 / W14 intercompany) — the cross-entity order
- Transfer pricing (links to VS-72 / W2594 TP documentation, VS-17 / W235) — the IC pricing
- Revenue recognition (links to VS-17 / W9, VS-157) — the selling-entity revenue

steps.activity: System manages cross-entity: Depot Inc. inventory fulfills Digital Commerce Inc. order; intercompany transfer pricing applied; revenue recognized by selling entity; monthly reconciliation per VS-17

fields.Participants: Ecom Quality Coordinator, Ecom Ops Manager

Automation Opportunity: - Sample auto-selected (risk-based); quality-score auto-fed to source-performance
Controls: - CTL-197: order-routing/fulfillment accuracy — pick-fraud detection; operational: Ecom Ops Manager corrective-action sign-off
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sample-blindness risk**: 100 of ~9,900 weekly ecommerce orders is a tiny sample; mitigated by the risk-based sample (high-error sources weighted) and the customer-return data (W2308) as the population signal
- **Error-detected-not-fixed risk**: errors are found but the root cause isn't addressed; mitigated by the corrective-action requirement and the follow-up audit
System Touchpoints: - Quality audit (links to VS-31 / W110 quality, VS-133 OpEx process-mining) — the quality-check methodology
- Order/inventory (links to VS-10 / W98, VS-05) — the order details audited
- Source-performance (links to VS-60 / W2303 source comparison) — the per-source quality score

steps.activity: Random 100 orders/week: correct items, quantities, packaging, label, timely dispatch; quality score by source; >2% error rate triggers corrective action

Automation Opportunity: - Express routing auto-filtered (in-radius-with-stock); SLA auto-tracked with premium-refund on miss
Controls: - CTL-410 (ensure controlled execution — Split-Order & Mixed-Basket Fulfillment (PA-60.2).)
- CTL-410 (express-SLA integrity); operational: Ecom Ops Manager express-SLA-miss review
Pain Points / Risks: - **SLA-miss risk**: the 4-hour SLA is missed due to pick/pack/3PL-pickup delay, requiring a refund of the express premium; mitigated by the cutoff (12 PM) and the in-radius-with-stock precondition
- **Store-capacity risk**: express orders surge during peak, overwhelming store pick capacity; mitigated by the express-volume-cap per store per hour
System Touchpoints: - Express routing (links to VS-60 / W2286 routing, W548 on-demand) — the in-radius-with-stock routing
- Premium 3PL (links to VS-56 / W548) — the GrabExpress/Lalamove integration
- SLA (links to VS-60 / W2292) — the premium-SLA clock (4-hour)
Time Estimate: ~Same-day per order; Ecom Ops Manager ~4 hours/day during express window = **~1,000 hours/year** (absorbed into ops).

steps.activity: Routes only to stores with stock in radius; cutoff 12 PM; premium 3PL (GrabExpress, Lalamove Priority); store picks/packs in 2 hours; 3PL pickup in 1 hour; delivery in 4 hours; premium SLA tracking
